results.title: Opa Papa
results.overview: A carefree young man discovers he has a son and returns to his small Armenian village, where fatherhood, village life, and unexpected love turn his world upside down.

results.title: Unidentified Murder
results.overview: Alien Alert!!! An influencer couple staged a harmless prank in pursuit of clicks and likes. Little do they know, their little escapade has gone out of control and spiraled into a real tragedy. A series of accidents, followed by blackmails and Extraterrestrial Encounters somehow echo and unveil the myth of a myterious child disappearnace 25 years ago! A group of five, a chain of bizzare events, layers of schemes and plot twists. It's all-you-can-experience in One Crazy Night!

results.title: Le ragazzine stanno perdendo il controllo. La società le teme. La fine è azzurra.
results.original_title: Le ragazzine stanno perdendo il controllo. La società le teme. La fine è azzurra.

results.title: Two for Tee
results.overview: Tee is a Chinese American pottery artist who meets new community center handyman Will. As she learns about her family's traditions through art, can she and Will save the center from closure?

results.title: BALL PIT
results.overview: A father haunted by a childhood trauma is forced to confront his worst nightmare when a ball pit appears at his daughter's birthday party.

results.title: Extra Time
results.overview: Stepbrothers and teammates Zhenya and Tyoma do not like each other. Professor Maksim Muromtsev, Tyoma's father, is working on a time machine. After a visit to his laboratory, they are accidentally transported to 1999, where they meet 12-year-old Vadim Shipachev - a future star hockey player and Zhenya's idol. Now they must help Vadim to believe in himself and follow his dream before they can return to the present.

results.title: Everybody to Kenmure Street
results.overview: In May 2021, a UK Home Office dawn raid triggers one of the most spontaneous and successful acts of civil resistance in recent memory. In Pollokshields, Scotland’s most diverse neighbourhood, hundreds of residents rush to the streets to stop the deportation of their neighbours.

results.title: Querida abuela
results.overview: What would you be willing to do for your grandmother?

results.title: The Morrigan
results.overview: Archaeologist Fiona travels to Ireland to uncover a long-dead tomb. A threat is released and she will have to fight to keep her teenage daughter from falling under the control of The Morrigan, a vengeful Pagan War Goddess.

results.title: Burdened
results.overview: After a tragic car crash leaves their mother in a coma, 19-year-old Dakota is forced into adulthood as she becomes the primary caregiver for her younger brother, Zach, a young boy struggling with severe ADHD. Torn between grief, guilt, and her own stalled future, she must decide how much of herself she can give without disappearing.

results.title: Jackie the Stripper
results.overview: A female empowerment grind house comedy action thriller. Jackie and her band of female vigilante assassins hatch a plan to kill six members of the evil male dominated court. With deadly and hilarious consequences

results.title: Kamathipura Express
results.overview: A young Polish man, Osa, has been living in the slums of Mumbai for some time, escaping the responsibilities of adulthood. He falls in love with Sapna, a teenage dancer, whose family is deep in debt and poverty. When Sapna's father tries to sell her to a brothel, the couple is forced on a desperate run across India, away from Kamathipura, Mumbai's red-light district.  "Kamathipura Express" is a winner at 2026 edition of the Student Academy Awards.

results.title: Tight Lettuce
results.overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

results.title: The Eyes
results.overview: Seo-jin, a renowned photographer, is shattered by the sudden and mysterious death of her twin sister and sets out to uncover the truth. As her investigation deepens, an unseen presence begins to close in, twisting reality and driving her into a spiral of paranoia as her vision fades away. Now trapped in encroaching darkness, Seo-jin faces a terrifying revelation that shatters everything she thought she knew.

results.title: Take Me Home
results.overview: Anna, a middle-aged Korean adoptee with a cognitive disability, cares for her aging parents in a fragile balance of meeting one another’s needs. Alongside her sister Emily and her father, they must confront challenging questions about the future, but Anna remains determined to build a life where all of them can thrive.

results.title: Free Fall – Who You Are
results.overview: Marc’s world unravels when a secret affair with fellow officer Kay forces him to choose between the life he built and the truth he can no longer deny. Free Fall – Who You Are is a reimagined recut of the 2013 cult film Freier Fall. Expanding beyond a coming-out story, Free Fall - Who You Are asks a deeper question: what happens when an honest life truly begins?

results.title: Neurosis
results.overview: During a hypnosis session, Anaïs passes through the sensory doors of her traumatic memory, meeting her first love Fred and her best friend Clarissa again in the rooms of her inner psyche, but her overly intrusive therapist often interrupts her visions.

results.title: Butterfly
results.overview: Two sisters raised on a charter resort in Gran Canaria. After 27 years, they reluctantly return to their childhood island to deal with their parents death, and end up with a half-finished esoteric retreat center in the Canary Islands.

results.title: Horrorcane
results.overview: A couple leases a south Florida estate that's home to an antique mirror which is a gateway to other dimensions - including a malicious demon realm - and once in, there may be no getting out. Vengeful contractors, supernatural entities, and a psychopathic realtor further complicate matters, all while the coast braces for a fast-approaching mega storm.
